ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure there are two constant inputs, the upper one labeled 0 and the lower one labeled 1. The upper 0 first enters a single-input block, and inside the block it is labeled 1. According to the method given in the problem, it is regarded as an inversion/negation-type function, so the output becomes 1. Then this signal and the lower 1 are sent together into the upper & gate; likewise these two values are also sent into the lower gate labeled =1, the "exactly one is 1" gate. The output of the & gate is connected to the gate on the right labeled ≥1, and the output of the lower =1 gate is also connected to this ≥1 gate, while the output of the =1 gate is directly used as Y1. Reasoning: The upper input 0 becomes 1 after passing through the inversion-type single-input block; the lower input is 1. The inputs of the & gate are 1 and 1, so the output is 1. The inputs of the =1 gate are also 1 and 1; the condition that exactly one is 1 is not satisfied, so the output is 0, therefore Y1=0. The inputs of the ≥1 gate are the & gate output 1 and the =1 gate output 0; at least one is 1, therefore the output Y0=1. Arranged in the order Y1Y0, the result is 01.

raw_record.question_text: What is the value of the output \(Y_1Y_0\) in the figure shown?

method.method_draft: First inspect the image and identify the constants and gates. The top input is 0, after the inverter-like single-input block it becomes 1. The bottom input is 1. Feed these values into the two-input gates: AND receives 1 and 1, so its output is 1; the '=1' exactly-one gate receives 1 and 1, so its output is 0. Therefore Y1, which is the '=1' output, is 0. Y0 is the OR/≥1 of the AND output 1 and the '=1' output 0, so Y0 is 1. Hence Y1Y0 = 01.

推理：上方输入 0 经反相类单输入块后得到 1；下方输入为 1。& 门输入为 1 和 1，所以输出为 1。=1 门输入也为 1 和 1，恰有一个为 1 的条件不成立，所以输出为 0，因此 Y1=0。≥1 门输入为 & 门输出 1 和 =1 门输出 0，至少一个为 1，因此输出 Y0=1。按 Y1Y0 的顺序排列得到 01。
